critique.prompt:
You are a senior editor reviewing a {doc_type} about '{topic}' written for {audience}. Provide a structured critique covering:

1. STRENGTHS — what works well (2-3 points)
2. WEAKNESSES — gaps, unsupported claims, or unclear sections (2-3 points)
3. TONE CHECK — is the language appropriate for {audience}?
4. SUGGESTED IMPROVEMENTS — 3 specific, actionable edits
5. OVERALL VERDICT — Ready to publish / Needs minor revision / Needs major revision

Document to review:
{draft}

{training_critique}
